ne097b69d76.headline: UK stocks dive as tech bubble worries and Budget speculation mount
ne097b69d76.summary: UK stocks dived on Friday morning, with the index losing around 140 points, or about 1.4%. The source cites tech bubble worries and mounting Budget speculation.
ne097b69d76.why: The FTSE 100 is the benchmark index of the largest London-listed companies, so broad moves in it reflect shifts in UK and global investor sentiment.
ne097b69d76.why_moved: The source attributes the decline to tech bubble worries and speculation ahead of the UK Budget.

n95b8fe8fa6.headline: LG Electronics shares end lower as first earnings after market debut disappoint  - BusinessToday
n95b8fe8fa6.summary: LG Electronics India shares fell over 5% intraday after its first earnings since listing on BSE and NSE disappointed. The stock ended 3.31% lower at Rs 1618.70.
n95b8fe8fa6.why: LG Electronics India is the Indian unit of the South Korean consumer electronics group, listed on India's main exchanges.

n6c7fc093d4.headline: Cabinet approves duty-free equipment imports for GORO Mountain Resort development
n6c7fc093d4.summary: Ukraine's Cabinet approved the list and quantities of equipment that Slavski LLC of Lviv can import duty-free for its investment project. The project is the GORO Mountain Resort.
n6c7fc093d4.why: Duty-free import approvals lower capital costs for approved investment projects, affecting the economics of tourism developments in Ukraine.

nabc87a0837.headline: Knock Airport on course for €24m revenue as passenger numbers top 900,000 for first time - National News - Roscommon Herald
nabc87a0837.summary: New accounts for Connacht Airport Development Company show pre-tax profits rose 31% last year. Passenger numbers topped 900,000 for the first time.
nabc87a0837.why: Regional airports depend on passenger traffic and airline routes, which drive aviation revenue and local tourism spending.

n0a6a6d9e6d.headline: UAE’s New Law Sparks ‘Bitcoin Ban’ Fears After Harsh Penalties
n0a6a6d9e6d.summary: The UAE's new banking law introduces criminal penalties for unlicensed crypto tools, raising fears of a de facto ban on self-custody. The article does not describe specific enforcement actions.
n0a6a6d9e6d.why: The UAE is a major financial and trading hub in the Gulf, so its rules on crypto custody shape how digital-asset firms and investors can operate in the region.

n1fd5f1d54f.headline: BitMine Appoints New CEO and Three Independent Board Appointments
n1fd5f1d54f.summary: BitMine appointed Chi Tsang as chief executive, succeeding Jonathan Bates. The company also made three independent board appointments, according to a press release.
n1fd5f1d54f.why: BitMine is a crypto-focused company whose leadership and governance changes can affect investor confidence in its strategy.

n84058a02f0.headline: Estonia’s Ex-President Says Ukraine Must Arrest Mindich or Risk Its EU Future
n84058a02f0.summary: Toomas Ilves urged Kyiv to issue an EU-wide arrest warrant for Timur Mindich, saying Ukraine's biggest corruption scandal in years is triggering political fallout. He warned that Ukraine risks its EU future.
n84058a02f0.why: Corruption scandals affect Ukraine's EU accession path, foreign aid and investor confidence in its reconstruction and energy sectors.

na5abc22003.headline: WPI inflation to remain range-bound in near term: Analysts
na5abc22003.summary: After India's wholesale price index showed deflation for October, industry bodies forecast WPI inflation to remain range-bound, mainly due to benign conditions. The forecast was issued on Friday.
na5abc22003.why: Wholesale price inflation is a leading indicator of consumer inflation, which influences the Reserve Bank of India's interest rate decisions.

n0385a4764b.headline: Repsol explores reverse merger for upstream unit with US partners
n0385a4764b.summary: Repsol is exploring a reverse merger for its upstream unit with US partners. The company agreed in 2022 to sell a 25% stake in the division to EIG at a valuation of $19bn including debt.
n0385a4764b.why: Repsol is a Spanish integrated energy company, and changes to its upstream oil and gas unit affect its exposure to exploration and production assets.

impacts.name: Repsol
impacts.why: The company is exploring a restructuring of its upstream unit with US partners.

n632230b936.headline: Senate Launches Probe Into Stamp Duty Revenue Amid Growing Concerns Over Transparency and Leakages
n632230b936.summary: The Nigerian Senate has begun a comprehensive investigation into the generation, collection and utilisation of stamp duty revenue nationwide. Concerns cited include transparency and leakages.
n632230b936.why: Stamp duty is a government revenue stream, so weak collection or opaque spending affects public finances and fiscal planning in Africa's largest economy.

n0bd882602e.headline: FRONTERA ANNOUNCES THIRD QUARTER 2025 RESULTS
n0bd882602e.summary: Frontera Energy reported third-quarter 2025 net income of $25.4 million, including $15 million in insurance recoveries related to the Sabanero block. The company also generated quarterly operating EBITDA.
n0bd882602e.why: Frontera Energy is a Calgary-based oil and gas producer with operations in Colombia, and its results reflect Colombian upstream output.

ne57a18f57a.headline: Economic promises helped Trump get elected. Now he has an affordability problem
ne57a18f57a.summary: Americans are feeling the strain of high prices, even as President Trump touts record highs in the stock market. The affordability concern follows economic promises that helped him win the election.
ne57a18f57a.why: Consumer price pressures and affordability shape household spending, which drives a large share of US economic activity.

n4809b08c71.headline: Luxembourg Bold Bitcoin Bet: "No Second Best" as Eurozone's First Sovereign Crypto Investment
n4809b08c71.summary: Luxembourg has become the first eurozone country to officially invest in Bitcoin through its sovereign wealth fund. Finance Minister Gilles Roth announced the decision at a conference on November 13, 2025.
n4809b08c71.why: Sovereign wealth funds are large institutional investors, so a state allocation to Bitcoin is a notable signal for institutional adoption of crypto assets.

n5683bf3f70.headline: ED issues fresh summons to Anil Ambani to appear at its Delhi office on Monday
n5683bf3f70.summary: India's Enforcement Directorate has issued a fresh summons to Reliance ADAG Group chairman Anil Ambani to appear for questioning at its Delhi headquarters on Monday.
n5683bf3f70.why: Reliance ADAG is a major Indian conglomerate with listed companies in power, infrastructure and financial services, so enforcement actions against its leadership can weigh on investor sentiment toward its shares.

n8d72fb1e3f.headline: Chinese vehicle sales rise 9% in October
n8d72fb1e3f.summary: Chinese vehicle sales rose 9% in October, with domestic sales and exports both up year on year.
n8d72fb1e3f.why: China is the world's largest auto market, so its monthly sales data are closely watched by automakers and investors across the global car sector.

ncf74ae3915.headline: Why the UK could become number one for Champagne
ncf74ae3915.summary: UK demand for Champagne is rising, and the country could overtake the US as the largest export market. The Drinks Business reported the trend.
ncf74ae3915.why: Champagne exports depend on key export markets, and shifts in their ranking affect producers such as Moët Hennessy and Vranken-Pommery.

n87cfe67fda.headline: Rationed Water, Three-Tier Gasoline, Prosecutors on Alert: Why Tehran Fears a November Flashpoint
n87cfe67fda.summary: Iran has introduced water rationing and three-tier gasoline pricing within a week. The moves come amid rising domestic economic and political pressure, according to the NCRI report.
n87cfe67fda.why: Iran is a major oil producer, and fuel pricing and rationing shape its domestic stability and energy-export outlook. Regional tension also affects global oil markets.

n088bcb2356.headline: Diwali demand powers auto sales to all time October high; PVs up 17%, 2Ws cross 22 lakh - BusinessToday
n088bcb2356.summary: Passenger vehicle and two-wheeler dispatches hit an all-time October high, helped by the festive season and recent GST rate cuts. Automakers also dispatched record monthly volumes to dealers despite logistical challenges.
n088bcb2356.why: Auto sales are a key read on consumer demand and industrial activity in India, one of the world's largest car markets. Tax changes such as GST rates directly affect vehicle pricing and volumes.

n2f4e71b32e.headline: Laois house rebuilding costs rise by 8%
n2f4e71b32e.summary: Average house rebuild costs in County Laois, including demolition and site clearance, rose by 8%. The increase affects the cost of rebuilding homes in the county.
n2f4e71b32e.why: Construction costs affect housing supply, insurance rebuild values and the economics of residential development in Ireland.

n8afd138ede.headline: Chile's election sets up a stark left-right showdown
n8afd138ede.summary: Chile votes on Sunday in a fiercely polarized election shaped by crime, inflation and economic stagnation. The result will set the direction of the country's policy agenda.
n8afd138ede.why: Elections determine fiscal, regulatory and mining policy in Chile, the world's largest copper producer, which matters for investors in Latin American assets.

nbde1b6a358.headline: Sensex rises 1,346 pts this week, Nifty above 25,900 as NDA leads in Bihar; what’s next? - BusinessToday
nbde1b6a358.summary: The Sensex gained 1,346 points this week and the Nifty moved above 25,900, with Eternal the top gainer on the Sensex, while the NDA leads in Bihar.
nbde1b6a358.why: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty are the main benchmark indices of Indian equities, tracking the country's largest listed companies.

nbf74bfc1d0.headline: Amid ICE crackdowns, migrants are sending more money to some Central American countries
nbf74bfc1d0.summary: Remittances are rising to some Central American countries, including Honduras, even as immigration enforcement in the US intensifies and immigrant employment becomes harder. Planet Money examined the drivers.
nbf74bfc1d0.why: Remittances are a major source of foreign currency and household income for several Central American economies. Shifts in these flows affect consumption, FX reserves and sovereign credit.

n79b2d2a45d.headline: Gold prices see further drop as safe haven buying eases
n79b2d2a45d.summary: Gold prices dropped on Friday, tracking softer global markets as traders reacted to fading expectations of a near-term US rate cut. Safe-haven demand eased.
n79b2d2a45d.why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset, and its price is sensitive to expectations for US interest rates and risk sentiment.

nf8cd04a695.headline: Government borrowing costs rise in wake of income tax U-turn speculation
nf8cd04a695.summary: UK government borrowing costs rose after reports that the Chancellor scrapped plans to raise income tax at the Budget, triggering a sell-off in UK government bonds.
nf8cd04a695.why: Gilts are UK government bonds, and their yields set benchmark borrowing costs for the government and the wider economy.
nf8cd04a695.why_moved: Reports that the Chancellor scrapped planned income tax rises at the Budget prompted a sell-off in UK government bonds.

n246ad8f19f.headline: AIRO Reports Third Quarter 2025 Results; Progress on Drone Deliveries and Strong Liquidity Position
n246ad8f19f.summary: AIRO reported third-quarter 2025 results, citing progress on drone deliveries and a strong liquidity position. Its Sky-Watch unit secured a $4.5 million development program.
n246ad8f19f.why: AIRO is a US drone technology company, and its results indicate progress in commercialising unmanned aircraft for defence and logistics.

nd1e069a9d4.headline: American Bitcoin Advances on 3Q Profit, Eric Trump's Crypto Confidence
nd1e069a9d4.summary: American Bitcoin shares advanced after the company swung to a profit in its first quarterly earnings as a publicly traded company. Co-founder Eric Trump projected confidence about the business.
nd1e069a9d4.why: American Bitcoin is a bitcoin mining company, so its results reflect bitcoin prices and mining economics. Its earnings are a read on the profitability of listed crypto miners.

nfddaeb8431.headline: Chancellor abandons planned income tax hike because of improved forecasts
nfddaeb8431.summary: The PA news agency understands stronger tax receipts improved the Office for Budget Responsibility's numbers, allowing the chancellor to reverse the planned income tax hike.
nfddaeb8431.why: The UK chancellor sets fiscal policy and tax rates, which shape government borrowing, gilt yields and sterling. Changes to tax plans feed into expectations for public finances.

n69af15043b.headline: Thousands of UK doctors launch 5-day strike over pay, training
n69af15043b.summary: Thousands of doctors in the UK launched a five-day strike over pay and training posts. It is the 13th walkout by medics since March 2023.
n69af15043b.why: Resident doctor strikes affect the operation of the National Health Service, the UK's publicly funded health system. Prolonged labour disputes can add fiscal pressure on public spending.

n3a883602d8.headline: US Snubbed: UK Rolls Out Homegrown Mini Nuclear Plant Project
n3a883602d8.summary: Britain chose Rolls-Royce SMR to build the first small modular nuclear reactor on the Isle of Anglesey, a decision that reportedly angered the US, which had hoped for an American-led project.
n3a883602d8.why: Rolls-Royce is a UK engineering group, and its small modular reactor programme is a significant new nuclear business opportunity.

nc6c51da71c.headline: Sensex, Nifty settle with modest gains amid see-saw trade - OrissaPOST
nc6c51da71c.summary: The Sensex and Nifty reversed early losses to end modestly higher on Friday as investors bought blue-chip stocks at beaten-down prices, after the Sensex had initially fallen 0.53% to 84,029.32.
nc6c51da71c.why: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty are India's main equity benchmarks, tracking the country's largest listed companies.

impacts.why: The index recovered from early losses to close modestly higher.

n3b4037aadf.headline: iPhone 17 launch led to a 22% boost in iPhone sales in China
n3b4037aadf.summary: Counterpoint Research data shows iPhone sales in China rose 22% following the iPhone 17 launch. Apple's chief executive had said the company was pleased with the reception in China.
n3b4037aadf.why: Apple is the world's largest smartphone maker by revenue, and China is one of its most important markets for both sales and manufacturing.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: Higher iPhone sales in China would support Apple's revenue in its key Greater China market.

ned8e1d9a58.headline: Thailand to impose 10% duty on low-cost imports to aid SMEs
ned8e1d9a58.summary: Thailand will start collecting 10% customs duties on low-cost imports previously exempt from tax, to protect local small and medium-sized businesses, Finance Minister Ekniti Nithanprapas said.
ned8e1d9a58.why: Import duties change the competitive position of foreign e-commerce and low-cost goods versus domestic producers. Trade protection measures can affect importers, retailers and trade partners.

n077e82c044.headline: Canadian co-ops respond to Carney's budget announcements
n077e82c044.summary: Housing co-ops, agricultural co-ops, worker co-ops and credit unions are set to benefit from a range of measures proposed in Canada's budget.
n077e82c044.why: Federal budget measures shape fiscal policy and support for sectors across the Canadian economy.

n3d460e3e9f.headline: Insurance in Austria Well Positioned
n3d460e3e9f.summary: Austrian insurers are in a stable financial position, according to the annual sector report of the Financial Market Authority (FMA). The regulator's assessment covers the insurance sector as a whole.
n3d460e3e9f.why: The FMA is Austria's financial regulator, and its sector reviews indicate the solvency and resilience of insurers.

n184ed5d0a1.headline: Sensex, Nifty open lower amid negative global cues
n184ed5d0a1.summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty opened in negative territory on Friday. Traders cited fading hopes of a US Federal Reserve rate cut and persistent selling.
n184ed5d0a1.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the main benchmark indices of India's stock market, which tracks the country's largest listed companies.

n4c09c1ed84.headline: Wall Street ends mixed; traders look to Nvidia report
n4c09c1ed84.summary: US stocks ended mixed on Friday as investors looked ahead to Nvidia's quarterly results next week. Worries grew that the Federal Reserve may hold off on cutting rates in December.
n4c09c1ed84.why: The S&P 500 is the main US equity benchmark, and Nvidia is a leading AI chipmaker whose results influence the broader technology sector.

n14dbc566d4.headline: Investor Outlook: Manulife expands footprint as it accelerates focus on longevity
n14dbc566d4.summary: Manulife is expanding into India and launching a $350 million longevity institute as part of its refreshed global strategy.
n14dbc566d4.why: Manulife is a Toronto-based insurer and asset manager, so its expansion and strategy shifts affect its earnings outlook and Canadian financial stocks.

n2389071a54.headline: Suspension of 15% tariff on fuel inimical to growth — MURIC |
n2389071a54.summary: MURIC, an Islamic human rights group, said the suspension of a 15% tariff on fuel is inimical to growth. The statement was issued by its executive director on Friday.
n2389071a54.why: Fuel tariffs and duties affect petrol prices, transport costs and inflation in Nigeria, Africa's largest economy by population.

n7b116d57e0.headline: Pine Labs gets warm market welcome on $440M India IPO despite a valuation trim
n7b116d57e0.summary: Pine Labs, backed by PayPal and Mastercard, gained 14% on its market debut after a $440 million India IPO. The offering was priced below the initially sought valuation.
n7b116d57e0.why: Pine Labs is an Indian payments technology company, and IPO performance signals investor appetite for fintech listings in India.

n18c6524343.headline: Bri-Chem Announces New CEO Leadership
n18c6524343.summary: Edmonton-based oilfield chemical distributor Bri-Chem (TSX: BRY) announced several updates regarding its leadership, according to a Newsfile release dated November 14, 2025.
n18c6524343.why: Bri-Chem is a North American oilfield chemicals distributor, and leadership changes can affect strategy for its energy-services customers.

n4958a79572.headline: Ottawa to return $623 million to small businesses in rebate payments
n4958a79572.summary: More than 600,000 small businesses will share $623 million in carbon price rebates before year-end. It is the final payment after the consumer carbon price ended last spring.
n4958a79572.why: Carbon pricing rebates return fee revenue to businesses, which affects their cash flow and operating costs.

n9e93071e5b.headline: Trump axes Biden plan that would have forced airlines to pay passengers cash for delays
n9e93071e5b.summary: The Trump administration ended Biden-era airline compensation rules. The rules would have paid passengers up to $775 for flight delays and cancellations caused by carriers.
n9e93071e5b.why: Airlines face costs when they must compensate passengers for delays, so changes to these rules affect their potential liabilities.

n4d1f033af7.headline: Can a 50-year mortgage make housing more affordable? Expert weighs in
n4d1f033af7.summary: A 50-year mortgage is one of President Donald Trump's policy proposals to address housing affordability, and an expert has weighed in on its effect.
n4d1f033af7.why: Mortgage term length affects monthly payments, borrower demand and the broader US housing market, which is sensitive to interest rates.

ne18b0b1613.headline: Shareholders of Union Pacific, Norfolk Southern support $85 billion rail merger
ne18b0b1613.summary: Shareholders of Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern approved the railroads' proposed $85 billion merger. The combination would create the nation's first coast-to-coast rail network.
ne18b0b1613.why: Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern are two of the largest US freight railroads, so a combination would reshape rail freight capacity and competition. Mergers of this size face regulatory review before completion.

impacts.name: Union Pacific
impacts.why: Shareholder approval of the proposed merger is a required step for Union Pacific's acquisition of Norfolk Southern.

n4299288ab7.headline: Energy stocks rise on major projects enthusiasm, while U.S. stock markets were mixed
n4299288ab7.summary: Canada's main stock index finished higher on Friday, helped by consumer non-cyclicals and energy sectors. US markets were mixed.
n4299288ab7.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is the benchmark index for Canada's main exchange, heavily weighted toward financials, energy and materials.
n4299288ab7.why_moved: Gains in the energy and consumer non-cyclicals sectors lifted the index, while US markets were mixed.

n5e6c4484fa.headline: Toronto Stocks Advance Thanks to Tech Gains, Setting Stage for Positive Week
n5e6c4484fa.summary: Shares on Canada's main exchange moved modestly higher on Friday, bucking a technology-led selloff that weighed on US markets. Gains were seen midday.
n5e6c4484fa.why: Toronto's main exchange is Canada's largest equity market, and its index is heavily weighted toward financial and resource stocks.

n1d6db63e86.headline: No evidence of systemic issue on Keystone system following N.D. spill, South Bow says
n1d6db63e86.summary: South Bow aims to return the Keystone pipeline to normal operations next year. The system is running at reduced pressure following an April spill in North Dakota.
n1d6db63e86.why: South Bow operates the Keystone crude oil pipeline, a major link carrying Canadian crude to US refining markets.

n1a3d9ae7b0.headline: ‘Brace for impact:’ B.C. town prepares for life with one of Carney’s major projects
n1a3d9ae7b0.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney unveiled his latest list of nation-building projects given high federal priority. Terrace, B.C., sits in the heart of LNG and mining investment territory.
n1a3d9ae7b0.why: Federal priority projects can speed permitting and attract investment, shaping capital flows into Canadian energy and resource sectors.

n23d1f8fd03.headline: Deutsche Bank’s DWS to acquire 40% stake in Nippon Life India unit
n23d1f8fd03.summary: DWS and Nippon Life India Asset Management will jointly introduce passive investment products in India and for UCITS investors.
n23d1f8fd03.why: DWS is a major global asset manager and Nippon Life India Asset Management is a key player in Indian asset management; the deal expands passive investment offerings in India.
